name: Turbo Hub design system
description: App-owned design language, extracted from existing screens in place.

components.name: Action

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Native button/link activation. Enabled actions press to 98% scale and return over 120ms per phase; reduced motion suppresses the scale. TurboUI.pressButton(control) reuses this visual feedback without dispatching activation. Caller supplies disabled and action/href; icon-only actions require a label. Decorative icon wrappers use inline-flex with block SVG to remove baseline offset; 20px glyphs center inside 44px icon targets. Accepts native type (button by default, submit for form actions). size=compact uses a 32px minimum height, 6px vertical/12px horizontal padding, 14px Medium type and a 16px icon; default labeled actions use a 56px minimum height and 16px vertical inset; icon-only actions use 44px. Camera variant owns a 44px circle, 8px inset, centered 24px filled glyph and white focus ring; label names the native icon-only control.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Own control semantics and input handling; caller owns action/selected value.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.button(); source and specimen use the same renderer. iconPosition=start (default) or end positions the decorative icon before/after the label. Default labeled actions use a 56px minimum height. There is no separate Tall variant; compact and icon-only configurations retain their own dimensions. variant='list' supplies a left-aligned 16px label and 44px icon well, 16px inset and 8px gap. Parent owns the grouped outline, rounded clipping and separate divider siblings; rows retain native link/button behavior. variant='danger' gives a reddish tint (--color-danger-soft) with red text (--color-danger) for declining or destructive actions; it combines with size='compact'. Prefer one danger action per screen, never the primary path. variant='camera' renders an icon-only 44px round translucent white action with a 24px Fill icon and white foreground, for camera/photo backdrops. It requires label and icon; quiet and compact options are ignored. Page owns backdrop, external placement and gaps. Disabled, hover, active and focus-visible retain native Action ownership. variant='glass' is a frosted translucent action with white text for blue chrome or full-blue screens. variant='warning' (amber tint, --color-warning / --color-warning-soft) marks a pending step that still needs the person, not an error. variant='inverse' is the primary action on full-blue Chrome screens (white fill, action-blue label), e.g. Done on Delivery confirmed; glass stays the secondary there. shape='pill' rounds it fully; a compact inverse pill puts its leading icon in a blue disc, available for a prominent create on chrome. New Hub uses the compact glass pill.

components.name: Avatar

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Caller supplies presentational content. editable=true composes the unchanged avatar with the registered Avatar edit action; wrapper owns lower-right placement.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Avatar is presentational; turbo-avatar-edit owns the optional edit button and focus. Caller owns onEdit behavior.

components.usage: TurboUI.avatar({name,large,graphic,size}); default 44px, large 64px, merchant 40px and hub 100px. Family Hub graphic uses the centrally mapped colored house illustration, with the Phosphor house retained as an image-error fallback. profile size is 56px with a 12px radius. Optional src takes precedence and renders a decorative image within the existing size; failed images restore the graphic or initials. Without src, known family names (Arun, Kavya, Neha, Rohan, with optional Sharma surname) resolve through TurboUI.avatarArtwork.users. Generic Family graphics resolve through TurboUI.avatarArtwork.home. The central artwork folder is assets/family-avatars; unknown names retain initials. No screen-specific image mapping is needed. graphic accepts a semantic icon name or the existing boolean configuration. Image is content, not an independent appearance variant. editable=true adds the registered edit action. onEdit, editLabel and editDisabled configure that child without page styling. size=contact is a 100px contact portrait with 20px corners, 32px initials or 40px graphic, compatible with editable=true. size=contact-medium is 80px with 16px corners, 28px initials and 32px graphics; supports editable=true. frame=true adds a subtle translucent white ring for tiles on the blue header (used by Hub summary tone='chrome'). badge='success' adds a small green tick at the bottom-right corner (decorative; the row or caller names the status). size='stack' is a 32px round face with a white ring for overlapping member groups; the parent owns the overlap. size='stack-large' is the same ringed round face at 40px for a standalone group, such as the members on Welcome to the Hub.

components.name: Badge

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Presentational data supplied by caller. No independently interactive children.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No owned interactions. Nested registered parts are presentational.

components.usage: TurboUI.badge(text,{variant}); default badge or compact role/relationship tag. Label is caller-supplied and noninteractive. variant='success' is a green status tag (e.g. Active). variant='warning' is an amber attention status; an optional icon (e.g. warning-circle) leads the label.

components.name: Spending limit summary

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Presentational data supplied by caller. No independently interactive children.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No owned interactions. Nested registered parts are presentational.

components.usage: TurboUI.limit({spent,limit,label,variant}); default horizontal or circular 45px progress. Accessible progress and clamped geometry; non-positive limits render an empty track. member variant displays a horizontal bar above spent/monthly-limit value columns. tone='glass' renders a frosted translucent card with white text and ring for the blue header. variant='setup' is the empty state before a limit exists: one centred button (icon, default plus, and action.label) in the card surface; tone='glass' makes it a frosted button on the blue header. action takes href or onClick.

components.name: Tabs

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Caller supplies selected; tabs emit onChange(label). Arrow/Home/End navigate and focus selected tabs.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Own control semantics and input handling; caller owns action/selected value.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.tabs(); source and specimen use the same renderer. tone='chrome' places the tabs on the blue header: labels hug their text and centre as a group; inactive 70% white, active white on a frosted pill; no underline, fill or divider. tone='segmented' is a soft track with the selected option as a raised white pill (Figma 515:76029), used for My Hubs / Shared with me at the top of the Hubs sheet.

components.name: Transaction row

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Presentational data supplied by caller. No independently interactive children.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No owned interactions. Nested registered parts are presentational.

components.usage: TurboUI.row({name,detail,amount,graphic,variant}); default inset or compact transaction row. Parent owns list gaps, separators and surface. Optional avatarSrc supplies a merchant image to the nested Avatar; row geometry and spacing are unchanged. Optional by='Neha' shows who made the payment as a caption under the amount; amount and name stack on the right and centre against the row.

components.name: Member card

anatomy.ownership: Member owns its identity and pending-message insets and divider. Nested Avatar, Badge and Limit own their geometry. Parent owns external list gap and placement.
anatomy.behavior: Presentational data supplied by caller. No independently interactive children.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No owned interactions. Nested registered parts are presentational.

components.usage: TurboUI.member({name,role,relation,pending,spent,limit,variant,statusText}); default card or profile card. Profile composes 56px Avatar, compact role/relationship Badges and member Limit, or a named pending message. No card-click behavior. chevron=true adds a right caret at the end of the identity row to signal the card opens member details.

components.name: Spending trend

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Presentational data supplied by caller. No independently interactive children.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No owned interactions. Nested registered parts are presentational.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.chart(); source and specimen use the same renderer.

components.name: Hub identity

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Presentational data supplied by caller. No independently interactive children.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Presentational identity; optional registered Action owns its native interaction states. Caller supplies action callback/href. Centered action preserves a 44px target.

components.usage: TurboUI.summary({name,type,variant}); default horizontal or centered identity. Caller owns content and placement. Optional action accepts registered button props; centered options action sits to the right of the hub graphic. tone='chrome' gives a white name and type for the blue header (Hub Details); the default 'surface' tone is for light backgrounds. On chrome, the avatar is framed and the subtext uses the 12px caption size. person='Kavya Sharma' shows that person's Avatar (portrait or initials) instead of the Hub graphic, for member profiles.

components.name: Phone status bar

anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal spacing and content; page owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: 56px high. Fixed 76px side slots leave camera clearance; centered Phosphor indicators share a visual centerline. Decorative mock status, not live device data. Caller supplies time (default 9:41).
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No interactions; time and indicators are presentational internal parts.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.statusbar({time: "9:41"}). The page owns the phone shell and viewport scaling. tone='light' is for screens whose top is white or light, such as an external messaging app or onboarding. The status bar has no fill of its own; the screen's Chrome backdrop (or other surface) paints behind it.

props.tone: chrome (default: white ink on the blue chrome) or light (dark ink, no fill, for white or light tops).

components.name: Text field

anatomy.ownership: Component owns label, control, internal spacing and error feedback. Page owns grouping and external gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Native accessible control. Caller supplies value/checked, disabled and callbacks. Field/select/check expose control and setError(text). Switch/check expose setChecked(boolean). Switch onChange emits proposed value; caller updates it with setChecked. Validation message sits below the bordered field surface. prominent=true uses the shared 16px Medium field value and prefix with a 2px label gap; semantics and validation stay unchanged.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns control semantics; caller owns application state and validation.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.field({id, label, ...}). IDs must be unique. See Add Member for composed form usage. variant='placeholder' displays a vertically centered input prompt instead of the small visible label; the associated label stays available to assistive technology. Placeholder defaults to label and disappears when typing. Surface has 60px minimum height, 12px vertical and 16px horizontal insets; validation remains below it. variant='digit' uses a blank, centered 64px-high box with 8px insets and a hidden accessible label, intended for a 44px-or-wider allocation in a segmented OTP. It retains Text field focus, disabled and input ownership.

components.name: Select

anatomy.ownership: Component owns label, control, internal spacing and error feedback. Page owns grouping and external gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Native accessible control. Caller supplies value/checked, disabled and callbacks. Field/select/check expose control and setError(text). Switch/check expose setChecked(boolean). Switch onChange emits proposed value; caller updates it with setChecked. Validation message sits below the bordered field surface.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns control semantics; caller owns application state and validation.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.select({id, label, ...}). IDs must be unique. See Add Member for composed form usage.

components.name: Switch

anatomy.ownership: Component owns label, control, internal spacing and error feedback. Page owns grouping and external gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Native accessible control. Caller supplies value/checked, disabled and callbacks. Field/select/check expose control and setError(text). Switch/check expose setChecked(boolean). Switch onChange emits proposed value; caller updates it with setChecked.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns control semantics; caller owns application state and validation. Optional turbo-info-pill owns its own activation; its state is independent of Switch.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.toggle({id, label, ...}). IDs must be unique. See Add Member for composed form usage. info=true adds the registered Info pill next to the label; omit description for title-only copy. onInfo is caller-owned and independent of switch activation.

components.name: Checkbox choice

anatomy.ownership: Component owns label, control, internal spacing and error feedback. Page owns grouping and external gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Native accessible control. Caller supplies value/checked, disabled and callbacks. Field/select/check expose control and setError(text). Switch/check expose setChecked(boolean). Switch onChange emits proposed value; caller updates it with setChecked.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns control semantics; caller owns application state and validation.

components.usage: Use TurboUI.check({id, label, ...}). IDs must be unique. See Add Member for composed form usage. Card choices use a soft gradient tint (tone='blue' default, 'violet' for UPI), a blue title and a custom 22px rounded checkbox that fills blue with a white check when selected; selection is carried by the checkbox, not a card colour change.

props.card: true renders the tinted choice card (title, description, price).
props.tone: Card only: blue (default, white to light blue) or violet (white to lavender), matching Figma Payment methods.
props.error: Inline error text; setError(message) updates it.
props.link: Optional {label, href, onClick}: an inline link at the end of the label, e.g. 'I agree to the Terms and conditions'. Clicking it never toggles the box.

components.name: Payment account

anatomy.behavior: Presentational account identity composes registered Avatar and Action. Caller supplies name/account and action callback; disabled prevents account change. No private child interaction states. Compact density uses 16px inset, 8px identity gap, 4px copy gaps and 16px account name.
anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal geometry; screen owns external layout.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Action belongs to turbo-button; Avatar is presentational.

components.usage: TurboUI.paymentAccount({name,account,onChange,disabled})

components.name: Swipe action

anatomy.behavior: Native range control, 0–100. Release at 95 or higher emits onComplete once and disables the control. Incomplete gestures reset. Keyboard Arrow/End keys are supported. Caller validates and owns the resulting flow. No real payment operation.
anatomy.ownership: Component owns internal geometry; screen owns external layout.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns range semantics and completion threshold; caller owns effect.

components.usage: TurboUI.swipeAction({id,label,disabled,onComplete})

components.name: Chrome backdrop

anatomy.behavior: One decorative backdrop. Follows the dimensions of its host; the parent owns size and layout. No variants, content or product controls. Optional motion is controlled globally by tokens and respects reduced motion.
anatomy.ownership: Decorative background and optional ambient motion only. Never sets foreground color, internal padding, child typography, hit areas or layout. Caller owns dimensions, clipping and placement.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No product controls or transition outputs. Supplied motion setting belongs to caller/global tokens. Registered child states remain with their owners.

components.usage: TurboUI.chromeBackdrop() creates an empty background element. TurboUI.chromeBackdrop({host:element}) paints an existing host without adding content. Parent owns dimensions; tokens own appearance and optional motion.

props.host: Optional existing element to paint; otherwise returns an empty div.

components.name: Navigation bar

anatomy.behavior: Equal 44px side slots keep title centered with absent or unequal action content. Long titles wrap. Caller supplies title and optional left/right Action options; Navigation forces icon-only quiet actions with accessible labels. Header title is 18px via --header-title-size; white icon actions have transparent backgrounds while retaining 44px hit areas. Its root is transparent so the shared Chrome backdrop remains continuous.
anatomy.ownership: Owns chrome geometry and title placement; Chrome backdrop owns the visual background; page owns surrounding header, status bar and screen layout.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No private interactions. Registered turbo-button children own activation, focus and disabled state; screen owns callbacks or href.

components.usage: TurboUI.navigation({title,left:{label,icon,href/onClick,disabled},right:{...}}). Omit either side as needed. Place inside turbo-chrome-backdrop for continuous phone chrome. variant='icons-only' omits visible title while preserving left/right action slots, geometry and accessible navigation label. Supports one or two icons.

components.name: Page header

anatomy.behavior: 20px Medium semantic screen heading with optional subtext, verified badge and decorative trailing icon or caller-provided visual. Long text wraps. Uses existing semantic icons; no actions.
anatomy.ownership: Owns title/subtext alignment, visual slot and internal spacing; Chrome backdrop owns the visual background; page owns placement within shared chrome.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Presentational only; no private controls.

components.usage: TurboUI.pageHeader({heading,subtext,verified,icon,visual}). Supply only icon or visual and place inside turbo-chrome-backdrop. Trailing visual is decorative; meaningful information belongs in heading/subtext. action: an optional trailing control aligned with the heading, e.g. a compact glass pill 'New Hub' Action on the Hubs list.

components.name: Request expiry countdown

props.label: Caption; default Request will expire after this time.
props.variant: default (time, track, caption) or inline (prefix and time on one line above the track; no caption).
props.prefix: Inline only: text before the time; default Expires in.

components.usage: White countdown for blue chrome surfaces. Caller owns the clock and expiry outcome; the renderer never starts a timer or submits a request. variant='inline' reads "Expires in 13:36" on one line above the track and omits the caption, for tight spaces such as just above an action sheet.

anatomy.ownership: Countdown owns 8px internal gaps, 8px track height and 10px radius. Parent owns outer padding and available width.
anatomy.behavior: Fluid width; caption wraps. setRemaining(seconds) updates timer text and accessible progress semantics. No hit area or transition callback.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Supplied remaining value belongs to the caller. Countdown owns timer/progressbar semantics; no interactive children.

components.name: Success indicator
components.usage: Decorative success check; caller supplies the visible result heading. No text, children or callbacks. The check is a registered heavy stroke (check-heavy, 34 units vs Phosphor bold 24). tone='action' colours it blue for full-blue screens such as Invitation sent. animated=true is for a flow's closing confirmation (e.g. Delivery confirmed): the circle springs in elastically, a halo ripples out and the check draws itself. It plays once when first in view (.play() replays) and settles to the final frame under reduced motion.

anatomy.ownership: Indicator owns its 81px circular surface and centered 32px check. Parent owns placement and gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Fixed dimensions, no interaction; aria-hidden because adjacent visible text describes the outcome.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No interactive children or state changes.

props.tone: success (default, green check) or action (blue check, for blue screens).
props.animated: false (default, static) or true (choreographed entrance: elastic circle, halo, self-drawing check).

components.name: Success notice

props.onDismiss: Optional callback. Caller owns removal; omitted callback omits the close action.

components.usage: Success feedback. No timer or automatic focus. Parent owns placement and lifetime.

anatomy.ownership: Notice owns 16px horizontal/8px vertical insets, 8px gaps and message typography. Action owns its hit area. Parent owns outer placement.
anatomy.behavior: Fluid width; message wraps. role=status announces feedback. Optional Action invokes caller dismissal; no automatic timer.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Dismiss belongs to registered Action; caller owns notice removal.

components.name: Radio choice

props.name: Native exclusive radio group name.
props.label: Accessible visible title.
props.checked: Initial supplied boolean, false by default. Native group owns subsequent exclusive selection.
props.onChange: Called with selected value on native change; caller persists application state.
props.size: default or prominent; prominent uses 16px title and description typography.
props.appearance: card (default) or list; list removes the individual outline and rounding for a parent-owned grouped surface.

anatomy.ownership: Owns 16px inset, 8px gaps and 24px native control. Parent owns group, legend and external spacing.
anatomy.behavior: Fluid width with wrapping text; native keyboard, focus and disabled semantics. Label activates input. Shared radio geometry uses a 24px ring and 12px selected dot. Mouse selection shows selection tint without a focus outline; input focus-visible exposes one row-owned keyboard outline. Forced colors retains native radio appearance.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Radio choice owns native activation and focus; caller supplies initial state and handles selected-value output.

components.usage: Use within a fieldset with a legend. Reuse one group name for mutually exclusive choices. size=prominent is the registered larger typography configuration used by Choose a Hub Type. appearance=list retains row padding and native selection; parent owns the shared outline, rounded clipping and inset dividers. appearance='list' has no selected fill; the radio carries selection.

props.name: Hub name, wrapping plain text.
props.type: Optional Hub category label; omitted by default (the Hubs list shows only the name).
props.members: Optional member names; first three render as an overlapping group of 32px stack Avatars using central family artwork or initials for unknown names. Accessible name announces total supplied count.
props.graphic: Tile: true (default) for the family home artwork, or a registered icon name such as briefcase or buildings for other Hubs.
props.spent: Optional amount spent this month across the Hub.
props.limit: Optional Hub monthly limit; when set, '₹spent / ₹limit' sits at the right of the name, above a full-width bar.
props.accent: Optional Hub colour: violet, teal or amber. Tints the card (corner wash and border), the tile (white surface, accent icon) and the spend bar; omit for the neutral card.

anatomy.ownership: Entry owns its cover layout: tile row (tile, overlapping member faces, chevron), name, spend line and bar. Avatar owns tile and face geometry. Parent owns list gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Fluid native link; one accessible name covering Hub, members and spend, with the visual parts hidden from assistive tech. Optional type, members and limit are omitted when not supplied.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Entry owns navigation semantics and its pressed (active) and keyboard focus states. No hover state, since this is a touch surface. Caller supplies destination. Nested Avatars are decorative.

components.name: Payment request notification

props.message: Plain wrapping request text; caller owns member/merchant/amount content.
props.href: Required destination for opening the request.
props.mark: payzapp (default, P tile) or whatsapp (green chat mark) for a messaging-app notification such as a Hub invitation.

anatomy.ownership: Owns 12px inset, 4px message gap, 8px header gap, brand mark and native link treatment. Parent owns lock-screen placement and wallpaper.
anatomy.behavior: Fluid link with wrapping plain text. Enter opens caller-supplied request. No live notification permission or delivery behavior.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns link hover/focus/active and native activation. Caller owns request data and destination.

components.usage: Use on a dark lock-screen preview; all text belongs to the consuming screen. mark='whatsapp' with app='WhatsApp' shows an incoming invitation message on the lock screen.

components.name: Account card

anatomy.ownership: Owns summary, surfaces and bank pills; parent owns placement and external gaps. Registered Account action owns its buttons.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: No parent interaction. Add money and Add card are turbo-account-action children; caller owns callbacks and disabled input.
anatomy.behavior: Fluid width, 90px minimum summary, 56px decorative icon. Long names wrap; linked pills scroll horizontally in a keyboard-focusable strip. Summary/wallet/linked variants; optional detail and empty cards supported.

components.usage: TurboUI.accountCard({name,detail,icon,variant,cards,actionLabel,disabled,onAction}). variant defaults to summary; wallet adds a labeled action; linked adds an icon action and bank pills. Content and disabled state are caller supplied. onAction is invoked by the child; no account operation is performed. Each cards item accepts {name,detail,initial,logo}; logo is an optional image URL, with initials restored if loading fails.

components.name: Account action

anatomy.ownership: Owns hit area, plus, typography and button state; parent owns placement.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Native button owns click/keyboard activation; caller owns disabled and onClick.
anatomy.behavior: Label action is full-width with 60px minimum height; icon-only action is circular 44px. disabled defaults false, suppresses native activation. Hover, active and focus-visible belong to this control.

components.usage: TurboUI.accountAction({label,iconOnly,disabled,onClick}). iconOnly defaults false and requires an accessible label. Caller supplies disabled and callback; no persistent selection state.

components.name: Avatar edit action

anatomy.ownership: Owns 36px button, 2px blue border, 3px white outer ring and 20px icon. Parent owns placement.
anatomy.behavior: Native labelled button; invokes supplied onClick, supports disabled and visible keyboard focus. Enabled edit actions share the Action press feedback (98% scale, 120ms per phase); reduced motion suppresses movement.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns edit activation; caller owns editing state.

components.usage: TurboUI.avatarEdit({label,onClick,disabled}); composed by editable Avatar.

components.name: Info pill

anatomy.ownership: Owns 28px pill and 16px icon; parent owns external gap.
anatomy.behavior: Native button with accessible label and supplied onClick callback.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns info activation; caller owns any sheet or explanation.

components.usage: TurboUI.infoPill({label,onClick}); omission of callback is a visual prototype only.

components.name: Action footer

anatomy.ownership: Owns translucent blurred surface, fade, 16px top/24px horizontal/12px bottom insets and 12px action gap. Parent owns bottom anchoring and scroll clearance.
anatomy.behavior: Full-width grid of registered Actions. Solid surface fallback when backdrop-filter unsupported.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Footer has no independent activation; nested turbo-button owns action semantics and state. Optional turbo-check owns acceptance interaction; caller controls Action eligibility.

components.usage: TurboUI.actionFooter({actions,label}); actions are Action API props. Overlay at bottom of a bounded scroll region and reserve content clearance for its height. Add Member demonstrates scroll-behind adoption without child style overrides. content accepts unchanged registered child nodes before actions, including an acceptance Checkbox choice. Caller owns acceptance and Action disabled state.

components.name: Range slider

props.label: Visible label; also names the control.
props.format: Formats the live value, aria-valuetext and min/max captions, e.g. Indian rupees.
props.onInput: Called with each new numeric value.
props.variant: default (label, output, endpoints) or media (compact white seek track with accessible label, no visible captions).

anatomy.ownership: Slider owns its label row, 6px track, 24px thumb, 44px hit height and captions. Parent owns width and external gaps.
anatomy.behavior: Native range input: pointer drag, arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home/End. setValue(v) and setRange(min,max) sync from other inputs (e.g. a Text field). Fluid width. Media variant owns a 24px high input, 4px white track, 10px thumb and hidden accessible captions.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns range semantics and aria-valuetext; caller owns the value, bounds and validation.

components.usage: TurboUI.slider({id,label,min,max,step,value,format,onInput}). Use when a value has a meaningful upper bound; pair with a Text field when exact entry matters and sync both with setValue. Shared typography uses --slider-label-size (14px), --slider-value-size (18px) and --slider-caption-size (14px), mapped to existing font-size primitives. Parent layout may narrow the available width without overriding Slider internals.

components.name: Verification code

props.id: Required unique aggregate input ID. Digit IDs append -digit-1 through -digit-6.
props.label: Group legend, default 6-digit code.
props.value: Initial numeric string, up to 6 digits; default empty. setValue(value) updates all boxes without emitting onInput.
props.disabled: Supplied availability propagated to all six Text fields.
props.error: Group validation message, default empty. setError(text) updates it and associates each digit with the message.
props.onInput: Receives the current numeric string after a user edit or aggregate input event.

anatomy.ownership: Verification code owns six-slot coordination, group legend/error and inter-field gaps; nested Text fields own digit controls and their visual states. Parent owns placement and available width.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Six registered turbo-field instances own native input/focus/disabled semantics. Verification code coordinates advance, paste, autofill, arrow and backspace navigation; caller owns submission and validation decisions.
anatomy.behavior: Six numeric text boxes, stable 64px height, fluid equal-width grid with 8px gaps (minimum group width 304px). Typing advances; empty Backspace clears/focuses the previous digit; arrows navigate; paste and SMS autofill distribute numeric digits. No automatic submit. Hidden aggregate control exposes the full value for forms and locked editorial playback. control is the aggregate; controls are visible digits; focus() focuses the first empty digit. Supplied partial/complete/error/disabled states are demonstrated through the same renderer. Direct child focus states belong to Text field.

components.usage: TurboUI.otp({id,label,value,disabled,error,onInput}); load forms.js before otp.js. Use setValue for programmatic state, setError for validation and focus for failed-submit recovery. The screen and specimen consume this same renderer.

components.name: Payment method

props.name: Method title, such as Card or UPI.
props.href: Destination; renders a native anchor when supplied, informational div otherwise.
props.status: Optional plain-text pending message, rendered by the registered warning Badge.
props.label: Optional accessible label describing the method and destination.

anatomy.ownership: Payment method owns row geometry, copy, native anchor semantics and chevron. Avatar and Badge own their unchanged appearance. Parent owns list gap and placement.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: The row is the sole interactive owner when href is supplied; Avatar, Badge and chevron are noninteractive children. Informational rows have no activation. Caller supplies destination and pending state.
anatomy.behavior: Plain fluid row extracted from Kavya’s profile: 8px vertical inset, 12px gaps, 2px title/detail gap. Identifier and title wrap; optional warning Badge precedes a decorative 20px chevron. Native anchor keyboard/focus behavior when linked; informational rows retain the existing profile chevron with no action. No activation or delivery state is inferred.

components.usage: TurboUI.paymentMethod({name,detail,graphic,href,status,label,id}); shared by member profiles and Neha’s first-visit Hub. Canonical fixtures use this renderer without overrides.

components.name: Interview card stack
components.usage: TurboInterviewStack(voices, {autoplay:true}); caller provides quote, type, accent and background. Only the top card is interactive; click, Enter or Space turns to the next quote. Autoplay is optional and pauses when focused, hovered, hidden or offscreen. Uses the case-study editorial tokens, distinct from mobile product typography.

anatomy.ownership: Stack owns card positions, cycling, motion, internal geometry and the card action; parent owns width and surrounding placement.
anatomy.behavior: Persistent folded note shapes. Hover reinforces the front outline without changing card geometry. Activation animates all cards on one 440ms timeline; the front note sweeps sideways and settles behind the deck. Resting positions commit before animation holds release. Repeated clicks during motion are ignored. Reduced motion switches instantly. Manual activation moves focus and announces position; background cards are disabled and aria-hidden. No visible instructions or counter.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Owns the single card-cycling action. Footer cue and counter are noninteractive parts of that button.

components.name: Hub introduction
components.usage: TurboUI.hubPromo({href,intro,title,description,label,variant}). variant defaults to v1 (original glossy blue-violet, artwork right). v2 is a two-tone near-white-to-cool-blue background gradient with neutral black/gray text and lighter weights, artwork left and a moving gradient-border highlight. Both retain the same original wallet asset and copy inputs. One full-card native link; no arrow, hover effect or nested CTA. In v2 only, wallet artwork gently floats 6px on a 4.8-second cycle. A soft reflection sweeps across the gradient border in 2.5 seconds; text stays still. Reduced motion disables both animations.

anatomy.ownership: Owns glossy surface, copy hierarchy, wallet artwork and internal spacing. Parent owns external placement and gaps.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: One native anchor owns navigation, touch active feedback and keyboard focus-visible. Caller supplies href and accessible label. Decorative shimmer has no input handling; no arrow or nested controls.
anatomy.behavior: V2 uses a two-tone near-white/cool-blue surface, 2px blue gradient border, wallet artwork on the left and neutral text. A soft light reflection sweeps across the border every 2.5 seconds; there is no travelling outline or rotating segment. Wallet floats 6px over 4.8 seconds. Text and layout stay still. Reduced motion disables both animations. Shared fluid geometry and optional content support remain unchanged.

components.name: Prototype walkthrough player

props.steps: Ordered labels and durations in milliseconds.
props.render: Receives index, elapsed, step, playing. Return false while loading.
props.autoplay: Start when visible unless reduced motion is enabled.
props.presentation: toolbar (default) or overlay: video-style controls inside media, with elapsed/total time and fullscreen.

anatomy.ownership: Player owns control layout and timeline; caller owns media rendering and available width.
anatomy.behavior: Play/pause, previous/next screens, backward/forward seek, loading hold, Replay, visibility pause. Overlay presentation uses registered glass icon buttons, media Range slider and fullscreen; caption remains accessible.
anatomy.interactionOwnership: Timeline state belongs to the player. Registered Action buttons and Range slider own their native controls and input states. Caption/media/counter are internal noninteractive parts.

components.usage: TurboPrototypePlayer.create({steps,media,render,autoplay,presentation})

patterns.name: Blue header + rounded content surface
patterns.summary: Default Turbo Hub screen layout: continuous blue chrome above a light content surface with 24px top corners.
structure: The .phone-screen adopts .th-chrome-backdrop so fixed status, navigation and optional page heading share one visual treatment.
The .phone-content surface fills remaining space with 24px top-left and top-right corners.
Content scrolls inside the surface. Optional footer and home safe area remain fixed.
requirements: Reuse prototypes/shared/phone-preview.css and phone-preview.js, and apply .th-chrome-backdrop to .phone-screen.
Every new Turbo Hub screen follows the rounded transition by default.
Keep product surfaces light and the preview backdrop dark gray outside the phone.
Page owns its content insets; preserve registered component internals.
patterns.behavior: Native registered controls own keyboard behavior; scroll remains inside .phone-content. Preview scales a fixed 390 × 844 viewport.
examples: Add Member details and payment methods

patterns.name: Bottom actions with blurred backdrop
patterns.summary: Keep shared Action footer anchored to the bottom while the bounded content scrolls behind its translucent blurred surface.
structure: Place the scroll region and a page-owned footer mount in the same grid area, with the mount aligned to the bottom.
Render TurboUI.actionFooter in the mount; supply registered Action props or unchanged Action nodes.
Reserve bottom scroll padding for the full footer plus a comfortable gap; keep the home indicator outside the scrolling area.
requirements: Use the shared Action footer renderer and its blurred surface; do not override Action sizing or component internals.
For one default Action, these examples reserve 112px bottom content clearance. Increase clearance to match multiple actions or wrapped labels.
Keep footer placement page-owned; do not make the entire document sticky.
patterns.route: Caller supplies Action destinations and callbacks. Native form submit buttons remain inside their form or use the form attribute.
patterns.behavior: Content alone scrolls. Footer remains bottom-anchored. Focused final controls must remain reachable above reserved clearance. Blur has a solid surface fallback.
patterns.responsive: Use the bounded phone viewport; footer spans its content width and buttons wrap naturally.
patterns.optionalRegions: Supports one or multiple registered Actions; no footer is needed when the screen has no bottom action.

screens.name: Member · Review payment

screens.name: Member · Neha profile (pending)

screens.name: Member · Verify PAN

screens.name: Member · Set UPI PIN

screens.name: Member · Neha ready to pay
